Plaque Maker

Turn artwork into a solid-color plaque with stacked relief. Each color can finish at a different height.

Artwork and colors

Use a transparent image or a plain background. Your artwork stays in this browser.

Height by color

Set each color’s top height above the print bed. The lowest tier forms the base. Each higher tier rests on the layers below it.

Plaque preview

Trace your artwork, set the heights, then build the plaque.

The 3MF includes Bambu P1S settings and filament colors. The STL ZIP includes a height guide for manual filament swaps.
